月光下的镜子剧烈地抖动起来，镜面上立刻浮现出两个字：一般。
邢烨微微挑眉：“还是个有自我意识的镜子，这是诱惑人心的魔鬼，砸了后用火烧掉吧。”
镜面上的字迹立刻变为“美丽”，且大写、加亮、加粗！
邢烨不为所动，眼皮都不眨一下，轮着石头砸下，在石块即将碰到镜面时，字再次发生改变，这一次是五彩艺术字的“帅”字。
“哦？”邢烨放下石头道，“你知道我的真实性别？”
镜子上的字消失，折射着美丽的月光，像一面普通的镜子。
“如果只是任务道具，应该不存在知晓玩家身份的情况；如果是有灵魂的任务NPC，当你认出克莱尔是男性时，我就应该收到任务失败的提示了。”邢烨捏着石头说，“所以，你是什么东西？”
镜子没反应，似乎就算邢烨将石头砸下去也不会说，它折射出的月光灰暗阴沉，带着一股浓浓的英勇就义感。
“不想说就不说，”邢烨放下石头，“目前来看，没有你剧情就进展不下去，虽然打碎镜子也有可能出现新的结局，但希望太渺茫，还是暂时接受你吧。”
镜中月光明亮了些。
邢烨将镜子带回木屋，旁白欣慰的声音传来：“克莱尔也无比喜爱这面镜子，即使恐惧，还是偷偷地抱紧镜子，将它放在自己枕边，在镜子的守护下，做了一个美丽的梦。”
邢烨：“……”
这游戏旁白算是完蛋了。
没有枕头的克莱尔用干草将镜子卷起来，直接把它当做枕头，枕着睡了一晚。
第二天早晨，邢烨啃掉剩下半个黑面包，坐在床上思索今天应不应该钓两条鱼改善伙食时，贝蕾卡急促的声音在门外响起：“克莱尔，大事不好了！”
邢烨伯爵要在领地的村庄中选择未婚少女作女仆！”
邢烨不为所动，女仆跟他有什么关系？
看到邢烨的脸，贝蕾卡更加惊慌了：“克莱尔你的脸怎么……”
她看起来相当惊讶，邢烨没有接话追问，只是摸摸自己的脸。
“你这样好漂亮……”贝蕾卡先是迷离一下，旋即清醒，抓着邢烨的手臂说，“我终于明白父母为什么不让我帮你洗脸，原来你是如此的美丽。不行，你不能被卢卡伯爵带走，他已经虐待死无数女仆了，他要是见到你，一定会……”

贝蕾卡说完猛地冲出房，几秒钟后糊了满手的泥巴回来：“克莱尔，忍一忍！”
眼见那一坨泥巴就要糊在自己脸上，邢烨一把抓住贝蕾卡的手：“他们要在这个村庄挑选几个女仆？”
“一个。”贝蕾卡被邢烨的气势压制住，呆呆地回答道，“卢卡伯爵的领地相当大，有数十个村庄，侍卫队不会将所有未婚少女都带走的，总要留一些人生孩子。”
被禁锢在土地上的农民吗？这里大概是中世纪农奴制前夕，农民还保留着一部分自由，贵族们尚未对农民进行人身奴役，采买女奴用得也是比较温和的手段。
按照这个时代背景，他如果一直困在这个村庄中，是永远无法接触到故事背景中的女王的，卢卡伯爵这件事应该是个契机。
按照贝蕾卡所说，他现在的长相很美，只要伯爵派来的人见到他，就一定会选择他成为女仆。
邢烨想了想剧情给克莱尔这个角色的设定，他抬手摸摸贝蕾卡的头，回忆着自己与弟弟说话的语气，尽可能柔和地说道：“就算不是我，也会是其他女孩子。我们都是朋友，我怎么忍心看着像贝蕾卡一样的女孩子被人带走呢？你离开了父母会伤心，但我就不一样了，我只有自己一个人，不会有家人流泪，我去是最合适的。”
他说得断断续续，极为不熟练。好在贝蕾卡心情激动，而且克莱尔的人设似乎就是这种善良的舍己为人的女孩，贝蕾卡并未怀疑他。
“可、可是……呜呜呜……”贝蕾卡说了几个字便承受不住，哭着跑了出去。
邢烨：“……”
跑什么啊，多给他提供点信息，比如卢卡伯爵的性格习惯、家庭背景和社会地位一类的情报。

content_en:
The mirror under the moonlight shook violently, and two words immediately appeared on the mirror: average.
Xing Ye raised his eyebrows slightly: "It is still a self-aware mirror. This is a tempting devil. After smashing it, burn it with fire."
The writing on the mirror immediately changed to "Beautiful", capitalized, highlighted, and bolded!
Xing Ye remained unmoved and without batting an eyelid, he hit the stone in turn. When the stone was about to hit the mirror, the word changed again. This time it was the word "handsome" in colorful artistic calligraphy.
"Oh?" Xing Ye put down the stone and said, "Do you know my true gender?"
The words on the mirror disappeared, reflecting the beautiful moonlight, like an ordinary mirror.
"If it is just a mission prop, there should be no situation where the player's identity is known; if it is a mission NPC with a soul, when you recognize Claire as a male, I should have received a mission failure prompt." Xing Ye pinched the stone and said, "So, who are you?"
The mirror didn't respond. It seemed that even if Xing Ye dropped the stone, it wouldn't say anything. The moonlight it reflected was gray and gloomy, with a strong sense of heroism and sacrifice.
"If you don't want to say it, don't say it." Xing Ye put down the stone. "At present, the plot cannot progress without you. Although breaking the mirror may lead to a new ending, the hope is too slim, so I'll accept you for the time being."
The moonlight in the mirror is brighter.
Xing Ye brought the mirror back to the wooden house, and the narrator's gratified voice came: "Claire also loved this mirror very much. Even though she was afraid, she secretly hugged the mirror tightly and placed it beside her pillow. Under the protection of the mirror, she had a beautiful dream."
Xing Ye: "..."
This game's narration is complete.
Claire, who had no pillow, rolled up the mirror with hay and used it as a pillow, sleeping on it all night.
The next morning, when Xing Ye gnawed away the remaining half of the black bread and was sitting on the bed thinking about whether he should catch two fish today to improve his food, Bereka's urgent voice sounded outside the door: "Claire, something bad has happened!"
Earl Xing Ye wants to choose unmarried girls as maids in the villages in his territory! "
Xing Ye was unmoved. What does the maid have to do with him?
Seeing Xing Ye's face, Beileka became even more panicked: "Claire, what's wrong with your face..."
She looked quite surprised. Xing Ye did not answer the question and just touched his face.
"You are so beautiful..." Beleka was confused for a moment, then woke up, grabbed Xing Ye's arm and said, "I finally understand why my parents didn't let me wash your face. It turns out you are so beautiful. No, you cannot be taken away by Count Luca. He has tortured countless maids to death. If he sees you, he will definitely..."
After speaking, Belica rushed out of the room and came back a few seconds later with her hands covered in mud: "Claire, bear with me! "
Seeing that the mud was about to smear on his face, Xing Ye grabbed Beileka's hand: "How many maids are they going to choose in this village? "
"one. "Beleka was suppressed by Xing Ye's momentum and replied dully, "Count Luca's territory is quite large, with dozens of villages. The guards will not take away all the unmarried girls. There must always be some left to give birth to children. "
Peasants imprisoned on the land? This was probably the eve of serfdom in the Middle Ages, and the peasants still retained some freedom. The nobles had not yet enslaved the peasants, and they used relatively mild methods to purchase female slaves.
According to the background of this era, if he had been trapped in this village, he would never be able to contact the queen in the background of the story. The matter of Count Luca should be an opportunity.
According to Belica, he looks very beautiful now, and as long as the people sent by the count see him, they will definitely choose him to become a maid.
Xing Ye thought about the setting of Claire's character in the plot. He raised his hand and touched Bereka's head, recalling the tone of his conversation with his brother, and said as softly as possible: "Even ifNot me, but other girls. We are all friends, how could I bear to watch a girl like Belika being taken away? You will be sad when you leave your parents, but it is different for me. I am alone, and there will be no family members crying. It is most appropriate for me to go. "
He spoke haltingly and in an extremely unskilled manner. Fortunately, Bereka was in an excited mood, and Claire's character seemed to be that of a kind-hearted girl who sacrificed herself for others, so Bereka did not doubt him.
"But...but...wuwuwu..." Beleka couldn't bear it after saying a few words, and ran out crying.
Xing Ye: "..."
Why are you running? Provide him with more information, such as Count Luca's character and habits, family background and social status.
